description: Canonical person model. All OS products are projections of this graph.

node_types.description: Enduring principles the person aspires to
Fundamental human needs (security, connection, autonomy, meaning, etc.)
Models the person holds about themselves, others, or the world
Current emotional/cognitive mode (calm, overwhelmed, grieving, hopeful, etc.)
Observed event associated with state change
Topics, tasks, or feelings the person tends to evade

stability.description: How consistently the edge has been observed

causal_confidence.description: Estimated likelihood this edge is causal
